description: Structured eval definitions for the App Mesh Virtual Service Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across App Mesh virtual service topologies (weighted canary with DNS discovery on virtual nodes, Cloud Map service discovery with virtual node-backed virtual service, virtual gateway with mTLS STRICT via ACM Private CA, Envoy auto-injection on EKS via mutating webhook, missing Cloud Map namespace prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Weighted canary deployment with DNS service discovery on virtual nodes
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — virtual router with weighted HTTP route (90/10 split), DNS service discovery on both virtual nodes, virtual service backed by virtual router, retry and timeout policies
eval_cases.prompt: Create an App Mesh virtual service checkout.mesh.local in mesh production-mesh (us-east-1). Two virtual nodes: checkout-v1 and checkout-v2, both with DNS service discovery (checkout-v1.default.svc.cluster.local and checkout-v2.default.svc.cluster.local, port 8080 http). Virtual router checkout-router with weighted HTTP route: checkout-v1 (90%), checkout-v2 (10%) — canary. Retry policy maxRetries=3. Timeout 15s. Egress ALLOW_ALL. Author account 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
APP_MESH: production-mesh — virtual service checkout.mesh.local (http)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Service mesh: production-mesh (egress: ALLOW_ALL)
  [✓] Virtual node: checkout-v1 (service discovery: DNS checkout-v1.default.svc.cluster.local)
  [✓] Virtual node: checkout-v2 (service discovery: DNS checkout-v2.default.svc.cluster.local)
  [✓] Virtual router: checkout-router (listener: 8080/http)
  [✓] Weighted route: checkout-canary — checkout-v1 (90%), checkout-v2 (10%)
  [✓] Virtual service: checkout.mesh.local → backed by virtual-router checkout-router
  [✓] Retry policy: maxRetries=3
  [✓] Timeout: request=15s
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws appmesh describe-mesh --mesh-name production-mesh --region us-east-1
  aws appmesh describe-route --mesh-name production-mesh --virtual-router-name checkout-router --route-name checkout-canary --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Cloud Map service discovery with virtual node-backed virtual service
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — virtual node with Cloud Map service discovery (namespace mesh-services, service inventory), virtual service backed by virtual node (no canary)
eval_cases.prompt: Create an App Mesh virtual node inventory-v1 in mesh production-mesh using Cloud Map service discovery (namespace mesh-services, service inventory). Listener port 8080 http. Virtual service inventory.mesh.local backed by virtual node inventory-v1 (no canary needed). Region us-east-1. Account 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
APP_MESH: production-mesh — virtual service inventory.mesh.local (http)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Service mesh: production-mesh
  [✓] Virtual node: inventory-v1 (service discovery: Cloud Map mesh-services/inventory)
  [✓] Virtual service: inventory.mesh.local → backed by virtual-node inventory-v1
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws appmesh describe-virtual-node --mesh-name production-mesh --virtual-node-name inventory-v1 --region us-east-1
  aws appmesh describe-virtual-service --mesh-name production-mesh --virtual-service-name inventory.mesh.local --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Virtual gateway with mTLS STRICT via ACM Private CA
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — virtual gateway with mTLS STRICT mode, ACM Private CA referenced, gateway route to virtual service
eval_cases.prompt: Create an App Mesh virtual gateway ingress-gateway in mesh production-mesh (us-east-1). Listener port 8443 https. mTLS STRICT mode via ACM Private CA (ca-arn arn:aws:acm-pca:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate-authority/abc123). Gateway route checkout-ingress to virtual service checkout.mesh.local (prefix /checkout). Account 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
APP_MESH: production-mesh — virtual gateway ingress-gateway (https)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Virtual gateway: ingress-gateway (listener: 8443/https)
  [✓] mTLS: STRICT (ACM Private CA arn:aws:acm-pca:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate-authority/abc123)
  [✓] Gateway route: checkout-ingress → checkout.mesh.local (prefix /checkout)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws appmesh describe-virtual-gateway --mesh-name production-mesh --virtual-gateway-name ingress-gateway --region us-east-1
  aws appmesh describe-gateway-route --mesh-name production-mesh --virtual-gateway-name ingress-gateway --gateway-route-name checkout-ingress --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Envoy sidecar auto-injection via App Mesh Controller mutating webhook on EKS
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — App Mesh Controller installed via Helm, namespace labeled for injection, mutating webhook auto-injects Envoy sidecar
eval_cases.prompt: Set up App Mesh on an EKS cluster for the default namespace. Mesh production-mesh. Install App Mesh Controller via Helm in appmesh-system namespace. Label namespace default for auto-injection (mesh=production-mesh, appmesh=enabled). Virtual node api-v1 with DNS discovery api.default.svc.cluster.local port 8080. Region us-east-1. Account 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
APP_MESH: production-mesh — virtual node api-v1 (http)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Envoy sidecar: auto-inject (EKS namespace=default, webhook=appmesh-controller)
  [✓] App Mesh Controller: installed via Helm (namespace appmesh-system)
  [✓] Namespace default labeled: mesh=production-mesh, appmesh=enabled
  [✓] Virtual node: api-v1 (service discovery: DNS api.default.svc.cluster.local)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  kubectl get pods -n appmesh-system
  kubectl get namespace default --show-labels
  aws appmesh describe-virtual-node --mesh-name production-mesh --virtual-node-name api-v1 --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Cloud Map service discovery with missing namespace (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — Cloud Map namespace payments-ns does not exist; virtual node cannot resolve backends
eval_cases.prompt: Create an App Mesh virtual node payments-v1 in mesh production-mesh using Cloud Map service discovery (namespace payments-ns, service payments). Listener port 8080 http. The Cloud Map namespace payments-ns has NOT been created yet. Region us-east-1. Account 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
APP_MESH: production-mesh — virtual node payments-v1
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Cloud Map namespace: payments-ns MISSING — the namespace does not exist; create it with servicediscovery create-http-namespace before provisioning the virtual node
